english.title: Bring animal which might threaten / annoy / soil a tram / tramstop / Information Centre of the Croydon Tramlink system
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the permission of the Operator or an authorised person, brought an animal, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ANIMAL..),

(A)_[onto a tram, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TRAM..), on]_
(B)_[onto a tramstop, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TRAMSTOP..),on]_
(C)_[into the Tramlink Information Centre of]_

the Croydon Tramlink system, which, in the opinion of an authorised person, may have threatened, annoyed, soiled or damaged a person or a part of such property
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 18(2) and 26 of the Croydon Tramlink Byelaws made under section 46 of the Croydon Tramlink Act 1994.
